newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Tyson, ESS off.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Tyson, ESS off.

text.p: Tyson Foods Inc shares retreated ahead of Friday's U.S. market open, the decline provoked by the company's warning of fiscal third quarter results lagging behind Wall Steet estimates.
Traders said Tyson stock fell to 19-5/8 from 21-9/16 at Thurday's Nasdaq close.

Late yesterday, the poultry producer said operating and margin pressures will cause it to post third quarter results under analysts' views. The First Call consensus of analyst estimates is $0.27 per share for the period, ending this month.
In last year's third quarter, Tyson reported earnings of $14.6 million, or $0.10 a share on sales of $1.6 billion.

ESS Technology Inc shares suffered after the company said it expects second quarter revenues "to only grow about 22 percent" versus the year ago period because of soft demand for audio products and competitive pricing pressures in the audio and video CD markets.
The shares fell to 12-1/4 from 14-5/8 in pre-open trade.
Second quarter sales are expected to be $56 to $61 million and earnings are forecast at $0.16 to $0.19 per share, before a one-time, $0.64 per share acquisition charge, ESS said.

Also in decline was Dentsply International Inc stock, which dropped to 47-1/2 from 50-3/8 in response to the company's announcement last night that it expects second quarter earings to be even with the $0.66 per share of the year-ago period.

The flat earnings were attributed to the relocation of the Preventive Care division's manufacturing facilities to a new plant in York, Pa., the recent acquisition of New Image Industries and the negative impact of the strong U.S. dollar on sales in European currencies, the x-ray eqipment company said.
